nodes.long_description:
1. Assemble the bones by reading the instructions
2. Build the organs from the instructions
3. Build the muscles using the instructions.
4. Play with the finished dog by tossing balls of chewing gum
nodes.short_description:
In virtual reality, place dog bones, organs, and muscles in the right places and label them with names and descriptions.
and learn the structure and role of dog bones, organs, and muscles.
